scripts.hook:stripe: if command -v stripe >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" ]; then stripe listen --api-key "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" --forward-to localhost:4000/webhooks/callback/stripe --events checkout.session.completed,customer.subscription.created,customer.subscription.updated,customer.subscription.deleted,invoice.paid,invoice.payment_failed; else echo 'Stripe CLI or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing: Stripe webhooks are not relayed locally (brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe)'; fi
scripts.hook:gitlab: if [ -n "$GITLAB_SMEE_URL" ]; then smee -u "$GITLAB_SMEE_URL" -p 4000 --path /webhooks/callback/gitlab; else echo 'GITLAB_SMEE_URL not set: GitLab webhooks are not relayed locally'; fi
